NAME
    update - Update inputs referenced by channels (optionally only a single
             role)

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] inputs channel update [command options] <channels> [role]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    --[no-]changelog     - (default: enabled)
    --[no-]commit        - 
    -d, --[no-]downgrade - 
    --[no-]editor        - (default: enabled)
